review:
San Quentin xWays is the Nolimit City prison slot with one of the biggest advertised max wins anywhere: 150,000x. xWays symbols stretch the reels and add ways, and the Lockdown spins – its free spins bonus – combine them with persistent features and multipliers into some of the swingiest bonus rounds you'll find.

Honestly, treat it as a curiosity to explore in the free demo first – real-money sessions can get very expensive before anything meaningful lands, and that headline number is a ceiling rather than something to plan around. High volatility, 96.03% RTP.
